text: dsh-subagent-model-notes（DSH 网页插件）：为子代理可选模型维护逐模型说明，并帮助委派 Agent 根据任务选择合适的 provider/model。它在插件设置页列出模型目录、当前授权状态和已有说明，用户可编辑并保存；宿主侧读取当前会话的子代理模型授权路由，只把对应的非空说明追加到系统提示词中，并放在可选择模型的子代理工具指引旁。适合配置多个子代理模型、希望 Agent 按任务区分其用途的用户。需要在 DSH 插件设置中授权子代理模型并填写说明；不要求额外 API 密钥。

dsh-subagent-model-notes is a DSH web plugin for per-model subagent guidance. Users edit notes beside the live model catalog and authorization state. For each session, it adds only notes matching authorized child routes to the prompt beside the delegation tool guidance. No extra API key is needed.
想给不同的子代理模型写用途说明，让委派 Agent 按任务挑模型。
怎样让 DSH 子代理知道哪个模型适合快速或复杂任务？
我想在设置页为每个可选的子代理模型填写备注。
让委派提示只包含当前会话已授权模型的说明。
How can I give my delegating agent guidance for choosing among child models?
I want to add a note for each model available to subagents in DSH.
dsh-subagent-model-notes 的功能「按模型编辑说明」：设置页显示模型及授权状态，用户可以为 provider/model 填写说明并保存。
dsh-subagent-model-notes 的功能「按授权路由筛选说明」：提示词组装时只保留当前会话可选择路由对应的非空说明，忽略未授权模型。
dsh-subagent-model-notes 的功能「将说明加入委派提示」：当提示中存在可选择子代理模型的工具时，将说明段放在该工具指引之后，供 Agent 选择子模型时参考。
dsh-subagent-model-notes 使用前须知：只有当前会话记录了非空的子代理模型授权路由，且存在可选择模型的委派工具时，说明才会进入系统提示词。
怎样把子代理允许使用的 provider/model 和对应用途说明一起提供给 Agent？
Can I make child-model selection use my descriptions of each provider/model route?

dsh-subagent-model-notes README · dsh-subagent-model-notes：[](https://github.com/097794/dsh-subagent-model-notes/actions/workflows/test.yml)

Per-model notes for **subagent delegation** in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH): a settings page beside the official **Subagent** page, and the same notes injected into the delegating agent's system prompt so it can pick the child model you planned.

```
Settings → Plugins → Built-in plugin settings → Subagent model notes
```

dsh-subagent-model-notes README · Why this exists：DSH lets you authorize an exact list of `provider/model` routes for child agents (`subagent-model-selection-settings`), and exposes `list_subagent_models` so the agent can discover them. But the authorized routes are only `{ provider, model }` pairs: there is no per-model description anywhere, and the model catalog carries no description for pi-ai providers. The delegating agent sees names and route ids — it has no idea when one model is the right choice.

This plugin adds that missing layer:

dsh-subagent-model-notes README · Why this exists：- a page listing every model the agent may choose, one editable note per model;
- the notes, filtered to the routes the **current Session** may actually select, appended to the system prompt right after the subagent tool guidance.

dsh-subagent-model-notes README · Install：Requires a DSH build with the plugin system (`dsh.bundle` + client modules), e.g. DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 desktop.

1. Clone or copy this directory somewhere stable.
2. Install it as a profile bundle — either:
   - **Plugins page** → **Add plugin** → local directory → select this folder, or
   - the plugin manager tool: `install_bundle` with the absolute path of this folder.
3. Keep the folder where you installed it: a local-directory install is linked, not copied.
dsh-subagent-model-notes README · Install：The bundle adds one row (`subagent-model-notes`) with a volatile `notes` config and the browser page that edits it.

dsh-subagent-model-notes README · Use：1. Open **Settings → Plugins → Built-in plugin settings**. Right below the official **Subagent** entry there is now **Subagent model notes**.
2. Fill in a note for each model you authorized, for example *"cheap and fast — boilerplate and low-risk tasks"*.
3. Save. On the agent's next step, the note reaches the system prompt; only routes that are both authorized and noted are included.

Rows are marked:

dsh-subagent-model-notes README · Use：| Mark | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| **Authorized** | The route is in the current Subagent allowlist; its note will reach the agent. |
| **Not authorized for subagents** | The note is stored, but has no effect until you authorize the route. |
| **Not in the current catalog** | The model is temporarily unavailable; its note is retained. |

dsh-subagent-model-notes README · How it works：- `system-prompt/assemble` waterfall listener; runs for every agent.
- Reads the Session projection `subagentModelSelectionPolicy` written by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent`. No policy means subagent model selection is off for that Session, and the plugin does nothing.
- Keeps only notes whose route appears in that policy.
- Finds the tool whose description advertises `list_subagent_models`, then inserts a `subagent-model-notes` section after its guideline section. The section uses `interpolate: false`, so note text is literal (a `{{...}}` in a note cannot break the prompt).
- Pure logic lives in `lib/prompt.js` and is tested without a harness.

dsh-subagent-model-notes README · How it works：- Registers a custom `plugins.item` page (`order: 11`, right after the official Subagent page).
- Reads and writes the volatile `notes` config through `ctx.configForms`, the same revision-fenced settings transport the official settings pages use.
- Loads the live model catalog through `ctx.remote.session.modelCatalog()` and reads the official allowlist through the `subagent-model-selection-settings` namespace, so the page always shows what the agent can actually choose.

dsh-subagent-model-notes README · Compatibility and risk：- Developed and verified against **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2** (Windows desktop). It relies on plugin-facing APIs that are stable in that build (`system-prompt/assemble`, `plugins.item`, volatile Config fields, `subagentModelSelectionPolicy`), but they are not a public compatibility promise. An upgrade may change them; treat this as a community plugin.
- The notes are **guidance, not enforcement**: the real allowlist is still enforced by the official Subagent settings. The plugin never calls a model or changes a route.
- Presets that keep a `complete` persona (for example `minimal`) collapse the assembly to that persona after the waterfall, so the notes section is dropped there — a harness constraint shared with other `system-prompt/assemble` plugins.
- Only Sessions composed with subagent model selection enabled receive the section, and only on steps assembled after you save.

dsh-subagent-model-notes README · Development：```sh
node --test test/prompt.test.mjs
```

`lib/prompt.js` has no DSH imports, so the routing/filtering/formatting rules and the section placement are testable with plain Node.
